one_liner: Cloud-based data warehousing platform providing REST APIs for data and resource management.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth, Bearer tokens (programmatic access tokens / JWT), password (basic), and keypair authentication.
access_notes: Snowflake offers a trial account to get credentials, but ongoing access requires a paid plan.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST APIs and Python SDK covering accounts, users, warehouses, databases, tables, and AI/ML services.
blocker_notes: Requires a paid plan or trial account after initial setup.

auth.quote: REST requests require a JWT token in the request header to authenticate the request. If you don’t have a JWT token, see Generate a JWT token.

api.quote: The Snowflake REST APIs for resource management provide a set of endpoints that lets users programmatically interact with and control various resources within the Snowflake Data Cloud.
